description: Land Title Settlement Department - Betugedara, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620294
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific declarations about land parcels, their ownership status (primarily "The State"), and detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extents, classifications, and reservations for specific purposes like streams, rivers, and canal roads. The content falls squarely within land and property-related matters as defined for Type 4 classification.
